equip_leveling.title: Equip Leveling
equip_leveling.config.title: Equip Leveling Configuration
equip_leveling.config.category.general.d: Core settings that affect how leveling feels. Hover any option for a plain-language explanation.
equip_leveling.config.category.reroll.de: How many XP levels it costs to reroll the enchanting table offers, based on how many enchantment slots are already filled.
equip_leveling.config.category.base_xp.d: How much XP each item type needs to reach its next level. Higher numbers mean the item levels up more slowly.
equip_leveling.config.category.ore_xp.de: How much XP you earn for mining different blocks with a pickaxe. You can also add your own blocks below.
equip_leveling.config.category.tiers.des: The order materials upgrade through when you get a legendary upgrade. Add or remove materials with the buttons.
equip_leveling.config.xp_multiplier.tool: Each level needs this much more XP than the last. 1.2 means level 2 needs 20% more than level 1.
equip_leveling.config.xp_threshold.toolt: Only XP gains at or above this number show a message. Set to 0 to see every gain.
equip_leveling.config.durability_restore: How much of the item's durability is repaired when it levels up.
equip_leveling.config.legendary_probabil: Chance that one of the three offers is a material-tier upgrade instead of an enchantment.
equip_leveling.config.upgrade_weight.too: How often offers upgrade an enchantment you already have, versus adding a brand new one.
equip_leveling.config.new_slot_weight.to: How often offers add a brand new enchantment to an empty slot.
equip_leveling.config.anvil_base.tooltip: Base XP level cost to repair an item at an anvil.
equip_leveling.config.anvil_per_level.to: Extra XP levels added to the repair cost for each level the item has.
equip_leveling.config.keep_on_death.tool: When enabled, items with level data stay in your inventory when you die. Other items still drop.
equip_leveling.config.broken_mechanic.to: When an item reaches zero durability it becomes [BROKEN] instead of disappearing. Repair it at an anvil.
equip_leveling.config.material_tiers.too: Materials upgrade in this order. Use the + button to add a material, the - button to remove one.
equip_leveling.config.reroll_cost.toolti: XP levels spent to reroll when %d standard slots are filled.
equip_leveling.config.base_xp.tooltip: XP needed for a %s to reach its first level-up.
equip_leveling.config.rare_ore_xp.toolti: XP for mining diamond, emerald, ancient debris and other rare ores.
equip_leveling.config.custom_block_xp.to: Add blocks that give XP when mined with a pickaxe. Format each entry as blockid:xp, e.g. minecraft:deepslate:25. Use the + button to add.
